title: Deployment Zone Size
question: When playing the Open Battle scenario on a 5 ft × 3 ft table instead of a 6 ft × 4 ft table, how deep should each deployment zone be?
answer: To preserve the Open Battle map's 24-inch gap between deployment zones, make each deployment zone 6 inches deep, measured from its long table edge. The front boundary of each zone remains 12 inches from the centre line, as shown in the map.
On a 5 ft × 3 ft table, the distance between the long table edges is 36 inches. Leaving a 24-inch gap in the centre gives each deployment zone a depth of (36 − 24) ÷ 2 = 6 inches.

This is an adaptation of the deployment map to a smaller table, rather than an explicit rule recommending a 5 ft × 3 ft battlefield. The Size of Battlefield rules recommend a minimum of 44 × 60 inches for games of 1,001–3,000 points, so agree on the smaller table with your opponent before playing.
